purpose: Freeze a traceable two-interval CHEMKIN/NASA polynomial set for the teacher-reference hydrogen and ethylene reaction branches before production solver integration.

coefficient_source.identity: GRI-Mech Version 3.0 Thermodynamics, released 1999-07-30, NASA Polynomial format for CHEMKIN-II
coefficient_source.official_context: University of California Berkeley GRI-Mech thermodynamic-data page states that GRI-Mech thermochemistry is based on standard databases including NASA-Lewis and Technion archives and publishes 298 K thermodynamic tables generated from the polynomial coefficients.
coefficient_source.mirror_header: GRI-Mech Version 3.0 Thermodynamics released 7/30/99; NASA Polynomial format for CHEMKIN-II
coefficient_source.coefficient_convention: Classic CHEMKIN NASA7 record. For teacher Chapter 11 cp/h equations this project stores a1..a6; a7 is entropy-only and is not used by the present model.

independent_sanity_source.identity: Berkeley GRI-Mech Thermodynamic Data at 298 K
independent_sanity_source.policy: Used only as an independent rounded-value regression check; the polynomial coefficients remain the computational source.

teacher_fuel_branch_coverage.note: Thermo-property readiness is not reaction/composition-closure readiness. The teacher Eqs. 11.27-11.29 still require their own closure implementation.

production_policy.reason: The source-backed core database now supports hydrogen and ethylene branches, but production state recovery should remain separate until piecewise data loading and regression checks pass and the intended supported-fuel scope is explicit.
production_policy.kerosene_policy: Do not invent C10H22 coefficients. Either recover a source-compatible pseudo-kerosene thermochemical record or keep the kerosene branch unavailable in the first teacher-reference integrated case.
